body: Should section 1.1 still be called "Validation and Sanitization Architecture" as Validation as moved to V2.

comments.body:
If to watch those 2 requirements, then none of them talks about input validation.

Easy choice is to follow the "chapter title" + Architecture and have "Encoding and Sanitization Architecture"?
Should this be the rule for all n.1 sections?
Although most are documentation and not architecture

Changes to discuss:
* "V1 Encoding and Sanitization" / "V1.1 Validation and Sanitization Architecture" > "V1.1 Encoding and Sanitization Architecture"
* "V2 Validation and Business Logic" / "V2.1 Validation and Business Documentation" > "V2.1 Validation and Business Logic Documentation"
  * Can be interpreted as "Validation Logic and Business Logic Documentation" / "(Validation and Business) Logic Documentation"
* "V5 File Handling" / "V5.1 Secure File Upload Documentation" > "V5.1 File Handling Documentation"
* "V14 Data Protection" / "V14.1 Data Protection and Privacy Documentation" > "V14.1 Data Protection Documentation"
  * Or is there a really good reason to have "and Privacy" in the section title?
* "V15 Secure Coding Architecture and Implementation" / "V15.1 Secure Coding Documentation" > ?
  * I think all those titles in V15 need some rethinking
* "V16 Security Logging and Error Handling" / "V16.1 Errors, Logging and Auditing Documentation" > "V16 Security Logging and Error Handling Documentation"
  * Although the requirement in about logging and the section title can be "V16 Security Logging Documentation"

Exception:
* "V11.1 Cryptographic Inventory and Documentation" - I think this makes sense, although it does not follow the naming pattern


Other note:
* "V10.1 Generic OAuth and OIDC security" > "V10.1 Generic OAuth and OIDC Security"

Note: in case we make any changes, we need to check if they are referenced from other places and update references as well.
